entries.1deac73685071a54: It sells ready-built homes, selling land and buildings as a set, mainly centered on Sakai City. This is the core business of the company group, pursued under the basic policy of applying fashionable architectural design to high-quality land and quality-focused homes.
entries.239020da60db9c10: A business that handles “contract homes” from real estate companies and “custom-built homes and renovation” from general customers.
entries.244472ed2db60ebe: Revenue of ¥3,130 million for the fiscal year ended March 2026 breaks down as follows: detached home sales business ¥3,093 million (ready-built home business ¥3,053 million, contract home business ¥39 million), real estate brokerage business ¥10 million, and real estate leasing business ¥26 million, with the ready-built home business accounting for 97.6% of the total.
entries.2680a7f24e8213ee: In the detached home sales business, customers are home buyers in the South Osaka area centered on Sakai City, and its core business, which forms the foundation, is the construction and sale of for-sale housing to first-time buyers. In the contract home business, it takes orders from real estate businesses and general customers, and in the real estate leasing business, customers are occupants and tenants of rental properties.
entries.2bfbcd9ae27e3df8: Provides three businesses: detached-house sales, brokerage and leasing
entries.2d233e0f8c1ead21: A business that plans, designs, builds and sells ready-built homes, contract homes and custom-built homes, with Sakai City, Osaka Prefecture and neighboring municipalities as its main areas. It carries out a consistent series of operations, from gathering land information, drafting business profit plans, land use planning, building planning and design, land purchasing, development applications, design work, purchasing materials and placing orders for outsourced construction, to process and construction management and repair work under after-sales service. The company is responsible, and the consolidated subsidiary Makoto design Kobo handles design work.
entries.3efba205ca6d8fec: A business that leases and manages office buildings and rental apartments owned by the company group. It is handled by the company and the consolidated subsidiary Makoto Estate.
entries.454b2f8103b6d248: The company states that, as a group of construction technologists, which is its management philosophy, its basic policy is “Provide better homes at lower prices,” and that it aims to become a total housing company that creates new value. For its medium- to long-term management strategy, the company states that it will maintain its locally rooted strategy based in the South Osaka area centered on Sakai City, and devote itself to building homes with an emphasis on quality and safety. In procuring land for sale in the ready-built home business, it considers profit margins and location and focuses on gathering information not only on medium-sized but also small-sized development properties, and it aims to expand the contract home business so that it, together with the ready-built home business, becomes the two pillars of its group. In its real estate brokerage department, the company states that it will focus on brokering other companies' properties as well as its own.
